partition_policy: Partition labels and expected outputs are frozen before implementation; heldout labels may not be edited after freeze.
reference_rules: Requirement/test/gate membership derives only from traceability edges.
Dependencies derive only from trace precedes, explicit order, or unique artifact producer-consumer evidence.
Conflict zones are assigned by lexically sorted shared write scope.
No automatic task splitting is allowed.
Execution state is replayed from append-only events tied to graph hash.
